decisions.reason: The award signal and the very recent launch make this yogurt look promising enough to keep while demand becomes clearer, especially in a growing organic food market.
Because management presented this cheese on the home page as a flagship product, it is a strategic option the firm is very likely to continue backing rather than withdraw early.
This semi-hard cheese has no strong success signal yet, but it is still a new product built on existing dairy capabilities, so the option value of waiting outweighs immediate withdrawal.
The spicy cheese is a narrower taste proposition and therefore riskier, but after only a short time on the market there is still too much uncertainty to justify dropping it now.
This mild creamy soft cheese appears to extend the range in a coherent way, so management would likely keep it on the market until sales evidence is more revealing.
The washed-rind soft cheese is relatively specialized and could be culled later if uptake disappoints, but at this stage the firm is likely to preserve the option and learn more first.
